name: Impurity
overview: The Bible clearly condemns impurity, especially sexual impurity, as a manifestation of the flesh that believers must reject. Passages such as Galatians 5:19 and Ephesians 5:3 instruct Christians to avoid fornication, uncleanness, and related sins, emphasizing that such behavior is unbecoming of those set apart as saints. Colossians 3:5 calls believers to actively put to death these earthly desires, highlighting their connection to idolatry. Furthermore, Hebrews 13:4 affirms the sanctity of marriage and warns that God will judge those who engage in sexual immorality, underscoring the seriousness with which impurity is regarded in Scripture.
